build_token_trie_from_hf_tokenizer: build a TokenTrie from a HuggingFace tokenizer to index all tokens as byte sequences in a trie
insert_token_bytes_into_trie: insert token bytes into a trie dictionary structure and mark the leaf node with the token id
load_tokens_as_bytes_into_trie: load all tokenizer tokens as bytes and insert each one into the trie for fast prefix lookup
review_token_trie_class: review the TokenTrie class and its methods for building a byte-level trie from an HF tokenizer
summarize_leaf_constant: summarize the LEAF constant used as a sentinel key to mark the end of a token path in the trie
